template.name: AuthorParticipation
template.desc: This template represents the Author Participation (including the author timestamp). CDA R2 requires that Author and Author timestamp be asserted in the document header. From there, authorship propagates to contained sections and contained entries, unless explicitly overridden. The Author Participation template was added to those templates in scope for analysis in R2. Although it is not explicitly stated in all templates the Author Participation template can be used in any template.

element.name: cda:templateId
element.desc: SHALL contain exactly one [1..1] templateId (CONF:1098-32017) such that it

element.name: cda:id
element.desc: This assignedAuthor SHALL contain at least one [1..*] id (CONF:1098-31473).
element.constraint: If the ID isn't referencing an author described elsewhere in the document, then the author components required in US Realm Header are required here as well.

element.name: cda:code
element.desc: This assignedAuthor SHOULD contain zero or one [0..1] code, which SHOULD be selected from ValueSet Healthcare Provider Taxonomy (HIPAA) urn:oid:2.16.840.1.114222.4.11.1066 DYNAMIC (CONF:1098-31671).

element.name: cda:assignedPerson
element.desc: This assignedAuthor MAY contain zero or one [0..1] assignedPerson (CONF:1098-31474).

element.name: cda:name
element.desc: The assignedPerson, if present, MAY contain zero or more [0..*] name (CONF:1098-31475).

element.name: cda:representedOrganization
element.desc: This assignedAuthor MAY contain zero or one [0..1] representedOrganization (CONF:1098-31476).

element.name: cda:id
element.desc: The representedOrganization, if present, MAY contain zero or more [0..*] id (CONF:1098-31478).

element.name: cda:name
element.desc: The representedOrganization, if present, MAY contain zero or more [0..*] name (CONF:1098-31479).

element.name: cda:telecom
element.desc: The representedOrganization, if present, MAY contain zero or more [0..*] telecom (CONF:1098-31480).

element.name: cda:addr
element.desc: The representedOrganization, if present, MAY contain zero or more [0..*] addr (CONF:1098-31481).
